local_dishes.name: Sri Lanka Rice and Curry (and papad)
local_dishes.description: The quintessential dish of the island, usually eaten at lunchtime

local_dishes.name: Fish ambul thiyal (sour fish curry)
local_dishes.description: Fish cut into cubes and sautéed in a blend of spices including black pepper, cinnamon, turmeric, garlic, pandan leaves and curry leaves; dried goraka gives the sour flavour

local_dishes.name: Kottu (kottu roti)
local_dishes.description: Made with godamba roti (a flat, crispy bread); the chef fries and chops the roti with ingredients you choose

local_dishes.name: Kukul mas curry (chicken curry)
local_dishes.description: Spices like fennel seeds, cardamom, cloves and cinnamon tempered in hot oil, then combined with chicken, chili powder, curry powder, turmeric, pandan leaves, lemongrass and curry leaves

local_dishes.name: Parippu (dhal curry)
local_dishes.description: The most common curry in Sri Lankan cuisine

local_dishes.name: Lamprais
local_dishes.description: Meat, rice and sambol chili sauce wrapped in a banana leaf packet and steamed; rice cooked in meat stock infused with cardamom, clove and cinnamon, served with mixed meat curry, two frikkadels, blachan and ash plantain or brinjals

local_dishes.name: Hoppers (appa or appam)
local_dishes.description: The Sri Lankan answer to the pancake; batter of slightly fermented rice flour, coconut milk, sometimes coconut water and a hint of sugar

local_dishes.name: Polos (green jackfruit curry)
local_dishes.description: Green jackfruit boiled until soft, then cooked with onions, garlic, ginger, mustard seeds, turmeric, chili powder, roasted curry powder, pandan leaves and curry leaves, simmered in coconut milk

local_dishes.name: Wambatu moju (eggplant/brinjal pickle)
local_dishes.description: Flavorful candied eggplant pickle served mostly with rice and curries

local_dishes.name: Gotu kola sambol (pennywort salad)
local_dishes.description: Shredded gotu kola (Asiatic pennywort, a medicinal herb) with shallots, tomatoes, fresh grated coconut and chili, dressed with salt, pepper and lemon juice

local_dishes.name: Pol Sambol (coconut relish)
local_dishes.description: Finely grated coconut, red onions, dried chilies or chili powder, lime juice, salt and Maldive fish; goes with rice and curry, pol roti, paratha, string hoppers or bread

local_dishes.name: Pol Roti
local_dishes.description: Warm roti with a taste similar to naan, made with wheat flour and scraped coconut

local_dishes.name: Ceylon Tea
local_dishes.description: Usually served black with milk and kithul jaggery, a cube of brown refined sugar

local_dishes.name: Kola Kanda
local_dishes.description: Traditional green herby concoction, almost like a herbal porridge, believed to help digestion, enhance immunity and reduce cholesterol; served in a bowl or glass

local_dishes.name: Toddy and Arrack
local_dishes.description: Toddy is a sharp local alcoholic drink made from the sap of palm trees in the first fermenting stages; arrack is a further fermented and refined version

local_dishes.name: Asmi
local_dishes.description: Rice flour kneaded with milk, made into a batter with coconut milk infused with cinnamon leaves, deep fried and garnished with treacle syrup

local_dishes.name: Vegetable curries (jackfruit/polos, beetroot, pumpkin, okra)
local_dishes.description: Jackfruit curry (polos), beetroot curry, pumpkin curry and okra curry, served with rice.

local_dishes.name: Dhal Curry (Parippu)
local_dishes.description: Red lentils cooked with coconut milk, turmeric, onions and mild spices, paired with pol roti, string hoppers or plain rice.

local_dishes.name: Pol Sambol
local_dishes.description: Spicy coconut relish of freshly grated coconut, red chili, lime juice and onions, paired with hoppers or rice.

local_dishes.name: Hoppers (Appa)
local_dishes.description: Crispy, bowl-shaped pancakes made from fermented rice flour and coconut milk.

local_dishes.name: String Hoppers (Idiyappam)
local_dishes.description: Delicate rice noodle nests, typically served with dhal, coconut sambol and vegetable curries.

local_dishes.name: Kiribath (Milk Rice)
local_dishes.description: Coconut milk rice cut into diamond shapes, eaten for breakfast or special occasions; served with lunu miris (chili-onion paste) or jaggery for a sweet version.

local_dishes.name: Vegetable Roti
local_dishes.description: Flatbread pockets filled with spiced vegetables, onions and potatoes, grilled or fried.

local_dishes.name: Brinjal Moju (Eggplant Moju)
local_dishes.description: Sweet, tangy and spicy pickle-style eggplant dish, often served with rice and curry.

local_dishes.name: Gotukola Sambol
local_dishes.description: Refreshing herbal salad of finely chopped gotukola (pennywort leaves), coconut and lime.

local_dishes.name: Coconut Roti (Pol Roti)
local_dishes.description: Flatbread made from grated coconut, flour and salt, lightly grilled and served with sambol or dhal.

local_dishes.name: Watalappan
local_dishes.description: Creamy steamed pudding made with coconut milk, jaggery, eggs and cardamom; Sri Lanka's take on crème caramel.

local_dishes.name: Coconut Pancakes (Pol Pani Pancakes)
local_dishes.description: Sweet coconut and jaggery filling rolled in a soft crepe; an evening snack.

souvenirs.item: Local Snacks & Sweets (Kalu Dodol, Milk Toffee, Cashews)
where_to_buy: Roadside cashew stalls near Minneriya and Kurunegala
